_about: Placed objects, new references, path grids, and the cells and land the patch makes, one way for the Python Editor and the viewer's: run by tests/test_place_cases.py (EditorSession) and viewer-shell/editcore/tests/cases.rs (editcore::places). Each case is a load order (`plugins`, each with its masters and its records in the tes3conv schema) and operations: ["ref_view", cell, origin, index], ["set_ref", cell, origin, index, field, value], ["revert_ref", cell, origin, index, field or null], ["place", cell, tag, id, translation, rotation or null], ["place_many", cell, [[tag, id, translation, rotation, scale]]], ["new_view", label], ["set_new", label, field, value], ["remove_new", label], ["new_cell", cell, absent], ["new_land", cell, height, texture, no_land, has_cell], ["duplicate_cell", cell, name], ["pathgrid_view", cell], ["set_pathgrid", cell, points, links], ["revert_pathgrid", cell], ["flat_land", grid, height, texture index], ["pending"], ["undo"]. A new reference's random editor name is given as a label (U1, U2, ... in the order the queue holds them), and a landscape's packed grids as sha256 of their bytes (their base64 depends on the zstd backend). `expect` is what each gave and the journal after them. Generated from the Python side when a case is added, and read by hand.
